# Respec Labs

> Respec Labs (respeclabs.com) is a game development consultancy founded by Daniele Nanni, a creative and game director with 25+ years in the games industry. It offers game studio consulting, fractional (interim) design leadership, career coaching, academic advisory for game design programs, and one-on-one career mentoring for students and recent graduates. Tagline: "It's time to level up."

## Founder
- Daniele Nanni (Dan Nanni), Founder & Principal Consultant
- Credits include Starfield, Fallout 76, Battlefield 4, Killzone 3, and Star Wars Battlefront II
- Studios: Bethesda, EA, Sony, Tencent, Gearbox
- Languages: English and Italian
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dnanni/

## Services
- Studio Strategist (for studios and dev teams): design team structure, hiring strategy, project direction, scope and milestone planning, development advisory
- Interim Leader & Coach (for leads and professionals): interim design leadership, management development, career advancement, mentorship, workplace communication
- Academy Advisor (for schools and programs): game design curriculum development, program consulting, workshops, guest lectures, career preparation
- Career Mentor (for students and new grads): one-on-one career path advice, job search strategy, portfolio, website, and résumé reviews, and interview prep, drawing on Daniele's years as a hiring manager and educator

## How engagements work
1. Free intro call
2. A plan with goals, priorities, and a scope of work that fits the team, timeline, and budget
3. Hands-on consulting, leadership, coaching, or mentoring with regular check-ins
